items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: There was a guy on the football team that delivered… his paper route was right next to mine, Robert Rivers... So I said, “Robert, I‟ll do your homework. You just walk me home for school every day”

ctx.x: Now over the years you had several nicknames. What was the first one?

[Laugh] My first one was Sporty. I guess my mother dressed me in Little Lord Fauntaroy suits and things. Then they called me… I started playing violin, they called me Black [Unintelligible] in school because I‟m playing violin. I had a tough time. I wore glasses, 13 years old with a violin and then those cats were playing basketball and football and they didn‟t want no time for me. I always had a tough time getting home without somebody beating me up some kind of way. So I finally found a way to beat it. I…
